chunks: And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم prohibited a man from casting his urine into the air from a rooftop or from an elevated thing.

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.يُطَمِّحَ: to cast or direct upward/outward into the air

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbid regarding urinating from a rooftop or elevated place?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a prohibition from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding a manner of relieving oneself from elevated places. It reflects Islamic legal and ethical etiquette concerning taharah (ritual purity), cleanliness, and proper conduct in bodily functions.
